| description = There are various kinds of lizard man mystics. In [[The Feerrott]], there is a low level version of this monster in the section of the zone connected to [[Oggok]], found in camps with other lizardmen. In [[Rathe Mountains]], there is "a lizard man mystic" and "lizardman mystic", both around level 10 but on different factions (by default, "a lizard man mystic" is peaceful and "lizardman mystic" is aggressive).

There is 3 different mobs with similar names. A lizard man mystic, A lizardman mystic and lizardman mystic.

"lizardman mystic" in [[Rathe Mountains]] is on [[Allize Volew]] faction and opposed to [[Allize Taeew]]; "a lizard man mystic" is on [[Lizard Man (Faction)]] faction.

Both "a lizardman mystic" and "lizardman mystic" in [[The Feerrott]] are also on [[Allize Volew]], as killing them will lower that faction and raise [[Allize Taeew]].
